    Split morphisms in an idempotent-complete preadditive category #

    This file constructs the complementary summand of a split monomorphism, and dually of a split epimorphism, directly by splitting the complementary idempotent. No kernel or cokernel is assumed.

    source
    structure LargeIndecomposable.SplitMonoComplement {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) [CategoryTheory.IsSplitMono f] :
    Type (max u v)

    A splitting of the idempotent complementary to a split monomorphism.

    • complement : C

      The complementary object.

    • inclusion : self.complement ⟶ Y

      Inclusion of the complementary object.

    • projection : Y ⟶ self.complement

      Projection onto the complementary object.

    • inclusion_projection : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp self.inclusion self.projection = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id self.complement
    • projection_inclusion : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp self.projection self.inclusion = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id Y - CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.retraction f) f
